1. Choose Allow installing apps\n2. Turn on Izuko TV Installer in the list (some TVs call this Unknown sources)\n3. Press Back to return here. If you don\'t, open Izuko TV Installer again from the home screen
It\'s still off. On some TVs the switch is elsewhere or has no effect; choose Continue and the system will ask again when installing.
This TV can\'t open that settings page. Choose Continue; the system will ask whether to allow it when installing.

Choose Install to open the system\'s install screen, then choose Install or Update there (Cancel is selected by default). Installing takes up to a minute; when it\'s done, choose Open. If the install screen closes halfway or nothing gets installed, use Install another way.

In the system window, choose Update or Install (Cancel is selected by default). If it says installing unknown apps isn\'t allowed, open Settings, turn on Izuko TV Installer, and come back. When it\'s done, open Izuko TV from the home screen.

In the system\'s install screen, choose Install or Update (Cancel is selected by default). If it says installing unknown apps isn\'t allowed, open Settings, turn on Izuko TV Installer, and come back. Installing takes up to a minute; when it\'s done, choose Open.

The install screen was closed. If you pressed Cancel by mistake (it\'s selected by default), choose Show the install screen again. If the system reported a parse error or another failure, choose Install another way.
Couldn\'t find the latest version: GitHub and its mirrors are all unreachable. Check the network and try again.
The download failed on every route. Try again; it resumes where it stopped.
Not enough storage: the installation needs about %1$s, but only %2$s is free.
Installing unknown apps isn\'t allowed for Izuko TV Installer. Turn it on in Settings, then retry.
The system blocked the installation. Allow this app to install unknown apps, then try again.
It conflicts with an app already installed: Izuko TV with a different signature, or a newer Izuko TV, is on this device.
This package isn\'t compatible with the device.
The package is damaged. Try again to download it from another route.
Diagnostics (take a photo of this screen when reporting a problem)
Xiaomi TVs may block third-party apps (\"prohibited features\" or \"abnormal package\"). Push the package from your phone with the Xiaomi TV Assistant app, or install it with ADB.
Some TCL / FFALCON TVs only install apps through TV Guard → Quick Install or the Huanshi assistant. Copy the package listed below to the root of a USB drive and install it with Quick Install.

Hisense / Vidda TVs need Store Mode turned on to install from a USB drive; you can also send the package from your phone with the Hisense app. If the TV later warns about a security risk, choose to keep using it.
Skyworth / Coocaa systems usually only install apps from their own store. Turn on ADB in the factory menu and install the package with ADB.
Some Changhong systems block third-party apps; only ADB or the system\'s own install channel works.
Konka: in the file manager, press the Menu key 5 times to unlock APK installation, or push the package from your phone with the Konka app.
Huawei / Honor smart screens: on HarmonyOS 4.3 and earlier, choose Trust when installing. HarmonyOS 5 (MateTV) can\'t install APKs.
LeTV systems may block or automatically uninstall third-party apps.
The system blocked the installation. Copy the package listed below to the root of a USB drive and install it with the TV\'s own file manager or media player, or install it with ADB.
Questions after installing, or it won\'t install? Scan a code to join and ask.

Use this if Install didn\'t work (the install screen closed halfway, or nothing got installed).\n\nYou won\'t see any progress this way: after you confirm, this installer closes and the system installs in the background. After about half a minute, open Izuko TV from the app list.
